title: Broad global selloff hits equities as AI trade unwinds
summary: VEQT fell to about $57.50 midday, down ~2.2% from the $58.82 prior close and ~7.9% over five sessions, still up ~7% year-to-date. The move was a broad global selloff centred on the AI trade unwinding (S&P, Nasdaq and Dow all down over 2% the prior day; Nikkei -4.5%), not VEQT-specific.
keyPoints: VEQT traded near $57.50 midday, about 2.2% below the $58.82 prior close.
Over five sessions VEQT was down about 7.9%; year to date it was up about 7%.
The S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow each fell more than 2% the prior day; the Nikkei fell 4.5%.
